## What does this file do?

- 規格與處理規則比照 2024 年版本 [`weather_taipei_2024_15min.Rmd`](weather_taipei_2024_15min.Rmd)：測站、缺值代碼、`D24R` 處理與時間格點定義完全相同，只更換年份與原始檔 manifest。
- 從 2025 年局屬氣象站天氣觀測資料（每日一檔，共 365 檔）中，只取「臺北」測站（`StationID` = `466920`，臺北市中正區）的溫度 `Temp`、相對濕度 `HUMD` 與日累積雨量 `D24R`，整理成**每 15 分鐘一列**的時間格點，供之後與 YouBike 站點資料以相同格點合併。
- 本檔是 `data/code/weather_taipei_2025.Rmd`（60 分鐘版）的 15 分鐘版本（組員 2026-10-19 決定改用 15 分鐘，以觀察尖峰時段的借還變化）。測站選擇、缺值代碼與 `D24R` 的處理規則完全沿用 60 分鐘版，只改變格點寬度。
- 為什麼 15 分鐘可行：臺北站觀測幾乎固定在每小時的 :00、:10、:30、:40（相鄰間隔 10 或 20 分鐘），所以每個 15 分鐘區間 (:45, :00]、(:00, :15]、(:15, :30]、(:30, :45] 正好各含一筆例行觀測（實際分布見下方輸出）。
- 選用臺北站的理由（組員 2026-10-18 決定）：臺灣大學站（`A0A010`）在 2024-01-19 才出現在資料中，且 2/9–2/16 有一段缺測；臺北站全年 366 天都有紀錄、缺值最少，距臺大約 2.5 km。重疊期間兩站逐時溫度相關係數 0.993（臺大平均低約 0.4 °C），有無降雨的日別一致率約 95%。此決定依 2024 年資料做成，2025 年版本沿用同一測站以維持兩年可比。
- 時間格點的定義：`datetime` = t 代表區間 (t − 15 分鐘, t]。
  - `D24R`：區間內**最後一筆有效觀測**（即 t 當下或之前、且不早於 15 分鐘的最新值）；區間內沒有有效觀測時為 `NA`，不用更早的值補，以免同一次雨量變動被計入兩個區間。
  - `Temp`、`HUMD`：t 當下或之前、**不早於 30 分鐘**的最後一筆有效觀測（組員 2026-10-19 決定）。臺北站偶爾改在 :20、:50 觀測（全年散見，不只一段期間），使部分 15 分鐘區間沒有讀數；若沿用 60 分鐘版「只用區間內讀數」的規則，約 4.2% 的區間溫濕度會缺值。溫濕度變化緩慢，10–20 分鐘前的讀數仍可代表當下。所用讀數距 t 的分鐘數記在 `weather_age_min`，下游可依需要改用更嚴格的門檻。
  - `rain`（降雨指標）：依組員 2026-10-18 的定義，區間內 `D24R` 有變動為 1，沒有變動為 0。實作上比較「t 之前最後一筆」與「t − 15 分鐘之前最後一筆」的 `D24R`。因為觀測間隔是 10／20 分鐘，每次讀數變動只會歸到一個區間，不會重複計算；例如 :00 的區間實際比較的是 :40 與 :00 兩筆讀數。
- `D24R` 的特殊處理（依 2026-10-18 對臺北站原始值的檢查）：
  - `D24R` 是當日 00:00 起的累積雨量；**00:00 那筆仍是前一天的全日總量**，00:10 起才歸零。因此每筆觀測的「累積日」定義為觀測時間減 1 秒所屬的日期；格點區間 (t − 15, t] 永遠落在同一個累積日內。
  - `-99` 為缺值，轉為 `NA`（臺北站 221 筆）。
  - `-990` 不是缺值：它出現在當日累積仍為 0 的時段，之後常接著 0.5 mm 以上的雨量，同一累積日內從不出現在正值之後（但有 4 次在之後退回 0），行為與「雨跡」（有降雨但未達 0.5 mm）一致。此解讀來自資料型態，**尚未在 CWA／TDX 文件中確認**。本檔將其記為 `D24R` = 0 並以 `D24R_trace` = TRUE 標示；預設「由 0 變成雨跡」也算 `D24R` 有變動（`TRACE_COUNTS_AS_RAIN`，可改為 `FALSE`）。
- 不使用風向、風速、氣壓、紫外線、能見度等欄位；不做補值。

## What does this file take?

- **Source Data Sets** (one entry per actual file):
  1. `data/code/weather_raw_manifest_2025.csv`
     - Input key: `weather_manifest`
     - Description: 2025 年 365 個原始檔的精確路徑、位元組數與 SHA-256，一檔一列（2026-11-08 以 `digest` 逐檔計算建立；2024 年的 `weather_raw_manifest.csv` 維持不變）。原始檔數量多，以此清單逐檔綁定，而不是用 glob 選檔。
     - Documentation: 本檔
     - SHA-256: `見下方 EXPECTED_INPUT_SHA256`
  2. `data/raw/weather_raw/局屬氣象站-天氣觀測報告資料2025-MM-DD.CSV`（2025-01-01 至 2025-12-31，共 365 檔，逐檔列於 manifest）
     - Input key: `weather_raw`
     - Description: TDX 局屬氣象站天氣觀測資料，35 欄，欄名與 2024 年相同；每檔含當日所有測站。本檔只讀取 `StationID`、`LocationName`、`ObsTime`、`Temp`、`HUMD`、`D24R`。
     - Documentation: `data/raw/weather_rental_codebook.md`
     - SHA-256: 逐檔記錄於 `data/code/weather_raw_manifest_2025.csv`，執行時逐檔核對

## What does this file output?

- `data/processed/weather_taipei_2025_15min.csv`
  - Output key: `weather_15min`
  - Description: 臺北站 2025 年每 15 分鐘天氣，一列為一個 `datetime`（區間 (t − 15 分鐘, t]）。欄位：`datetime`（`Asia/Taipei` 當地時間，`YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` 文字）、`Temp`（°C）、`HUMD`（0–1 比例，沿用原始單位）、`weather_age_min`（`Temp`／`HUMD` 讀數距 t 的分鐘數）、`D24R`（當日累積雨量 mm，雨跡記為 0）、`D24R_trace`（是否為雨跡）、`rain`（0／1 降雨指標）。
  - Role: `analysis`
  - Documentation: pending（processed-data 文件待建立）
  - Expected schema and row-count rules: 7 欄；35,040 列（2025-01-01 00:00 至 2025-12-31 23:45，每 15 分鐘一列）；`datetime` 不重複且連續；`rain` 只有 0、1、`NA`；`HUMD` 介於 0–1；`weather_age_min` 介於 0–30（不含 30）。
  - Verification status / SHA-256: 見最後一個 chunk 的實際輸出與下方「執行結果」。
  - Downstream finding input: 尚無（2025 年 YouBike × 天氣合併程式待建立）

All paths are relative to the project root, not the operating-system root.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

find_project_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  candidate <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(candidate, "AGENTS.md")) &&
        dir.exists(file.path(candidate, "templates"))) return(candidate)
    parent <- dirname(candidate)
    if (identical(parent, candidate)) stop("Open this notebook within the student project containing AGENTS.md and templates/.")
    candidate <- parent
  }
}
PROJECT_ROOT <- find_project_root()

project_file <- function(relative_path, area, must_exist = TRUE) {
  # Exact project-relative paths only; no first-file search or OS-root /data path.
  parts <- strsplit(relative_path, "/", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  if (grepl("^(/|~|[A-Za-z]:)", relative_path) || ".." %in% parts ||
      grepl("<", relative_path, fixed = TRUE) ||
      !startsWith(relative_path, paste0("data/", area, "/"))) {
    stop("Replace the placeholder with an exact path inside data/", area, "/: ", relative_path)
  }
  path <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, relative_path)
  if (must_exist && (!file.exists(path) || dir.exists(path))) stop("Input file not found: ", path)
  # Resolve existing ancestors to reject a path that leaves the project via a symlink.
  ancestor <- path
  while (!file.exists(ancestor)) ancestor <- dirname(ancestor)
  resolved <- normalizePath(ancestor, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  allowed <- normalizePath(file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "data", area), winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  if (!startsWith(allowed, paste0(PROJECT_ROOT, "/"))) {
    stop("data/", area, "/ resolves outside the project root.")
  }
  if (!identical(resolved, allowed) && !startsWith(resolved, paste0(allowed, "/"))) {
    stop("Resolved path leaves data/", area, "/: ", relative_path)
  }
  path
}

sha256_file <- function(path) {
  if (!requireNamespace("digest", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Cannot verify input identity: digest is unavailable. Use an available SHA-256 implementation before loading data.")
  }
  digest::digest(file = path, algo = "sha256", serialize = FALSE)
}

verify_input_sha256 <- function(path, expected) {
  # Bind this run to the exact file inspected when the notebook was prepared.
  if (!is.character(expected) || length(expected) != 1L || is.na(expected) ||
      !grepl("^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$", expected)) {
    stop("Fill the expected SHA-256 from the inspected input before loading data.")
  }
  actual <- sha256_file(path)
  if (!identical(actual, tolower(expected))) stop("Input changed: identify the new version before loading ", basename(path), ".")
  actual
}
```

## 綁定輸入檔

manifest 以固定 SHA-256 綁定；manifest 再逐檔綁定 365 個原始檔。

```{r}
INPUTS <- c(weather_manifest = "data/code/weather_raw_manifest_2025.csv")
EXPECTED_INPUT_SHA256 <- c(
  weather_manifest = "44becb779a1406e70d5003f31204d3a26963f9d1de34a786035b38ca828b622b"
)
OUTPUTS <- c(weather_15min = "data/processed/weather_taipei_2025_15min.csv")

input_paths <- c(weather_manifest = project_file(INPUTS[["weather_manifest"]], "code"))
output_paths <- vapply(OUTPUTS, project_file, character(1), area = "processed", must_exist = FALSE)
stopifnot(!any(output_paths %in% input_paths))
if (any(file.exists(output_paths))) stop("Review existing outputs before replacing them.")

input_fingerprints <- map_chr(names(input_paths), \(key) {
  verify_input_sha256(input_paths[[key]], EXPECTED_INPUT_SHA256[[key]])
}) |>
  set_names(names(input_paths))

weather_manifest <- read_csv(
  input_paths[["weather_manifest"]],
  col_types = cols(file_path = "c", size_bytes = "d", sha256 = "c")
)
stopifnot(
  nrow(problems(weather_manifest)) == 0L,
  nrow(weather_manifest) == 365L,
  !anyDuplicated(weather_manifest$file_path),
  all(grepl("^[0-9a-f]{64}$", weather_manifest$sha256))
)

# Verify every raw file against the manifest before loading any of them.
weather_manifest <- weather_manifest |>
  mutate(
    abs_path = map_chr(file_path, project_file, area = "raw"),
    source_date = as.Date(str_extract(file_path, "\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}")),
    actual_sha256 = map_chr(abs_path, sha256_file)
  )

changed_files <- weather_manifest |>
  filter(actual_sha256 != sha256)
if (nrow(changed_files) > 0) {
  stop("Raw files changed since the manifest was built: ", paste(basename(changed_files$file_path), collapse = ", "))
}
stopifnot(
  !anyNA(weather_manifest$source_date),
  !anyDuplicated(weather_manifest$source_date),
  all(year(weather_manifest$source_date) == 2025)
)
cat("All", nrow(weather_manifest), "raw files match their manifest SHA-256.\n")
cat("Date range:", format(range(weather_manifest$source_date)), "\n")
```

## 取出臺北站觀測

逐檔以文字讀入需要的欄位，只保留 `StationID` = `466920` 的列，並記錄每檔保留列數。

```{r}
STATION_ID <- "466920"
KEEP_COLUMNS <- c("StationID", "LocationName", "ObsTime", "Temp", "HUMD", "D24R")

read_station_rows <- function(abs_path, source_date) {
  raw_day <- read_csv(
    abs_path,
    col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
    col_select = all_of(KEEP_COLUMNS),
    progress = FALSE
  )
  stopifnot(nrow(problems(raw_day)) == 0L)
  raw_day |>
    filter(StationID == STATION_ID) |>
    mutate(source_date = source_date)
}

station_rows_chr <- map2(weather_manifest$abs_path, weather_manifest$source_date, read_station_rows) |>
  list_rbind()

rows_per_file <- station_rows_chr |>
  count(source_date)
stopifnot(nrow(rows_per_file) == nrow(weather_manifest))

station_rows_chr |>
  count(StationID, LocationName)
rows_per_file |>
  summarise(min_rows = min(n), median_rows = median(n), max_rows = max(n))
cat("Station rows read:", nrow(station_rows_chr), "\n")
```

## 型別轉換、去除重複與缺值代碼

同一觀測時間可能同時出現在相鄰兩天的檔案中；這些重複列的數值必須完全相同才去除。

```{r}
NUMBER_PATTERN <- "^-?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$"
stopifnot(
  all(station_rows_chr$LocationName == "臺北"),
  all(grepl("^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2} \\d{2}:\\d{2}:\\d{2}$", station_rows_chr$ObsTime)),
  all(map_lgl(c("Temp", "HUMD", "D24R"), \(column) all(grepl(NUMBER_PATTERN, station_rows_chr[[column]]))))
)

duplicate_times <- station_rows_chr |>
  distinct(ObsTime, Temp, HUMD, D24R) |>
  count(ObsTime) |>
  filter(n > 1)
stopifnot(nrow(duplicate_times) == 0L)

station_obs <- station_rows_chr |>
  distinct(ObsTime, Temp, HUMD, D24R) |>
  mutate(
    ObsTime = ymd_hms(ObsTime, tz = "Asia/Taipei"),
    across(c(Temp, HUMD, D24R), as.numeric)
  ) |>
  arrange(ObsTime)
cat("Duplicate rows removed:", nrow(station_rows_chr) - nrow(station_obs), "\n")

# Only these negative codes are expected: -99 (missing) everywhere, -990 (trace) in D24R.
station_obs |>
  summarise(
    Temp_minus99 = sum(Temp == -99),
    HUMD_minus99 = sum(HUMD == -99),
    D24R_minus99 = sum(D24R == -99),
    D24R_minus990 = sum(D24R == -990)
  )
stopifnot(
  all(station_obs$Temp > -90 | station_obs$Temp == -99),
  all(station_obs$HUMD >= 0 | station_obs$HUMD == -99),
  all(station_obs$D24R >= 0 | station_obs$D24R %in% c(-99, -990))
)

station_obs <- station_obs |>
  mutate(
    Temp = na_if(Temp, -99),
    HUMD = na_if(HUMD, -99),
    D24R_trace = D24R == -990,
    D24R = case_when(
      D24R == -99 ~ NA_real_,
      D24R == -990 ~ 0,
      .default = D24R
    ),
    # D24R accumulates from 00:00; the 00:00 reading still holds the previous day's total.
    accumulation_date = as.Date(ObsTime - seconds(1), tz = "Asia/Taipei")
  )

glimpse(station_obs)
summary(station_obs)
colSums(is.na(station_obs))
```

```{r}
# Check the D24R assumptions before using them.
TRACE_COUNTS_AS_RAIN <- TRUE
# Orders trace between 0 and 0.5 mm for change detection; not a rainfall amount.
TRACE_LEVEL <- if (TRACE_COUNTS_AS_RAIN) 0.1 else 0

d24r_obs <- station_obs |>
  filter(!is.na(D24R)) |>
  mutate(rain_level = if_else(D24R_trace, TRACE_LEVEL, D24R)) |>
  group_by(accumulation_date) |>
  mutate(level_drop = rain_level < lag(rain_level, default = 0)) |>
  ungroup()

# Within one accumulation day the reading should only stay flat or rise.
d24r_obs |>
  filter(level_drop) |>
  select(ObsTime, D24R, D24R_trace, rain_level)

midnight_check <- station_obs |>
  filter(!is.na(D24R)) |>
  mutate(clock = format(ObsTime, "%H:%M")) |>
  filter(clock %in% c("00:00", "00:10")) |>
  group_by(clock) |>
  summarise(readings = n(), positive = sum(D24R > 0))
midnight_check
```

## 建立 15 分鐘時間格點

每個 `datetime` = t 代表區間 (t − 15 分鐘, t]。各變數分別取最後一筆有效觀測，因為三個欄位的缺值不一定同時出現。`Temp`、`HUMD` 可回看到 (t − 30 分鐘, t]；`D24R` 只用區間內的讀數。

```{r}
# Observation minutes: 15-min windows work only if readings fall in every window.
station_obs |>
  count(obs_minute = minute(ObsTime))
station_obs |>
  count(gap_min = as.numeric(ObsTime - lag(ObsTime), units = "mins")) |>
  arrange(desc(n)) |>
  head(5)

WINDOW <- minutes(15)

quarter_grid <- tibble(
  datetime = seq(
    ymd_hms("2025-01-01 00:00:00", tz = "Asia/Taipei"),
    ymd_hms("2025-12-31 23:45:00", tz = "Asia/Taipei"),
    by = "15 min"
  )
) |>
  mutate(
    window_start = datetime - WINDOW,
    accumulation_date = as.Date(datetime - seconds(1), tz = "Asia/Taipei")
  )
stopifnot(nrow(quarter_grid) == 365L * 96L)

latest_in_window <- function(grid, obs, value_columns, max_age) {
  valid_obs <- obs |>
    filter(if_all(all_of(value_columns), \(value) !is.na(value))) |>
    select(obs_time = ObsTime, all_of(value_columns))
  grid |>
    select(datetime) |>
    left_join(valid_obs, join_by(closest(datetime >= obs_time))) |>
    # A reading older than max_age is not used for this period.
    mutate(
      usable = obs_time > datetime - max_age,
      across(all_of(value_columns), \(value) if_else(usable, value, NA)),
      obs_time = if_else(usable, obs_time, NA)
    ) |>
    select(datetime, obs_time, all_of(value_columns))
}

# Temp and HUMD change slowly: allow a reading up to two windows old (members' choice, 2026-10-19).
STATE_MAX_AGE <- 2 * WINDOW

temp_15min <- latest_in_window(quarter_grid, station_obs, "Temp", STATE_MAX_AGE) |>
  rename(temp_time = obs_time)
humd_15min <- latest_in_window(quarter_grid, station_obs, "HUMD", STATE_MAX_AGE) |>
  rename(humd_time = obs_time)
# D24R stays strictly inside the window so each change is counted once.
d24r_15min <- latest_in_window(quarter_grid, d24r_obs, c("D24R", "D24R_trace", "rain_level"), WINDOW) |>
  select(-obs_time)

# Temp and HUMD go missing together, so one age column describes both.
stopifnot(identical(temp_15min$temp_time, humd_15min$humd_time))

# Periods recovered by the longer look-back.
temp_15min |>
  summarise(
    in_window = sum(temp_time > datetime - WINDOW, na.rm = TRUE),
    from_previous_window = sum(temp_time <= datetime - WINDOW, na.rm = TRUE),
    missing = sum(is.na(temp_time))
  )
```

## 降雨指標

比較 t 之前最後一筆 `D24R`（區間終點）與 t − 15 分鐘之前、同一累積日內最後一筆 `D24R`（區間起點）。

- 同一累積日在 t − 15 分鐘之前沒有讀數時（例如 00:15 的區間），起點是累積日開始時的 0。
- 終點缺值 → `rain` 為 `NA`。
- 兩者相同 → 0；不同 → 1。依組員定義，只看「有沒有變動」，所以少數「雨跡退回 0」的下降也算 1（見下方輸出）。
- 兩者不同但起點讀數早於 t − 30 分鐘（2 × 區間寬度，與 60 分鐘版相同的規則）：變動可能發生在本區間之前，`rain` 為 `NA`，不猜測。

```{r}
start_readings <- quarter_grid |>
  select(datetime, window_start, accumulation_date) |>
  left_join(
    d24r_obs |>
      select(accumulation_date, start_time = ObsTime, start_level = rain_level),
    join_by(accumulation_date, closest(window_start >= start_time))
  ) |>
  mutate(
    # No earlier reading in this accumulation day: start from the 00:00 reset at level 0.
    start_time = coalesce(start_time, as.POSIXct(accumulation_date, tz = "Asia/Taipei")),
    start_level = coalesce(start_level, 0)
  ) |>
  select(datetime, start_time, start_level)

weather_15min_full <- quarter_grid |>
  select(datetime) |>
  left_join(temp_15min, join_by(datetime)) |>
  left_join(humd_15min, join_by(datetime)) |>
  left_join(d24r_15min, join_by(datetime)) |>
  left_join(start_readings, join_by(datetime)) |>
  mutate(
    weather_age_min = as.numeric(datetime - temp_time, units = "mins"),
    rain = case_when(
      is.na(rain_level) ~ NA_integer_,
      rain_level == start_level ~ 0L,
      start_time < datetime - 2 * WINDOW ~ NA_integer_,
      .default = 1L
    )
  )

stopifnot(nrow(weather_15min_full) == nrow(quarter_grid))

# Periods where the reading went down (trace back to 0); the rule still counts them as a change.
weather_15min_full |>
  filter(rain_level < start_level) |>
  select(datetime, start_time, start_level, D24R, D24R_trace, rain)

weather_15min <- weather_15min_full |>
  select(datetime, Temp, HUMD, weather_age_min, D24R, D24R_trace, rain)

glimpse(weather_15min)
summary(weather_15min)
colSums(is.na(weather_15min))
```

```{r}
# Values to note for downstream analysis.
weather_15min |>
  count(rain)

# Periods flagged only because D24R went from 0 to trace.
weather_15min_full |>
  filter(rain == 1L, D24R == 0, D24R_trace) |>
  nrow()

# Periods with rain = NA because D24R moved but the earlier reading is too old.
weather_15min_full |>
  filter(!is.na(rain_level), is.na(rain)) |>
  nrow()

weather_15min |>
  mutate(month = format(datetime, "%Y-%m")) |>
  group_by(month) |>
  summarise(
    periods = n(),
    rain_periods = sum(rain == 1L, na.rm = TRUE),
    rain_na = sum(is.na(rain)),
    temp_na = sum(is.na(Temp)),
    mean_temp = round(mean(Temp, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
  )

# Longest stretches of periods without a temperature reading.
weather_15min |>
  mutate(temp_missing = is.na(Temp), run = consecutive_id(temp_missing)) |>
  filter(temp_missing) |>
  group_by(run) |>
  summarise(first_period = min(datetime), periods = n()) |>
  arrange(desc(periods)) |>
  head(5)
```

## 寫出與讀回驗證

`datetime` 以 `Asia/Taipei` 當地時間的文字寫出（`write_csv()` 會把時間轉成 UTC，容易誤讀）；讀回時以同一時區解析。

```{r}
outputs <- list(
  weather_15min = weather_15min |>
    mutate(datetime = format(datetime, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"))
)
stopifnot(setequal(names(outputs), names(OUTPUTS)))

verification <- list()
for (key in names(outputs)) {
  path <- output_paths[[key]]
  if (file.exists(path)) stop("Output already exists; review it before replacing: ", path)
  frame <- outputs[[key]]
  write_csv(frame, path, na = "")
  reread <- read_csv(
    path,
    col_types = cols(
      datetime = col_datetime(format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
      Temp = "d", HUMD = "d", weather_age_min = "d", D24R = "d", D24R_trace = "l", rain = "i"
    ),
    locale = locale(tz = "Asia/Taipei"),
    na = ""
  )
  stopifnot(
    nrow(problems(reread)) == 0L,
    identical(names(reread), names(weather_15min)),
    nrow(reread) == 365L * 96L,
    !anyDuplicated(reread$datetime),
    all(diff(as.numeric(reread$datetime)) == 900),
    all(reread$datetime == weather_15min$datetime),
    all(reread$rain %in% c(0L, 1L, NA)),
    all(between(reread$HUMD, 0, 1) | is.na(reread$HUMD)),
    all((reread$weather_age_min >= 0 & reread$weather_age_min < 30) | is.na(reread$weather_age_min)),
    isTRUE(all.equal(as.data.frame(weather_15min), as.data.frame(reread), check.attributes = FALSE))
  )
  verification[[key]] <- list(
    data_path = OUTPUTS[[key]],
    rows = nrow(reread),
    size_kb = round(file.size(path) / 1e3, 1),
    schema = map_chr(reread, \(column) paste(class(column), collapse = "/")),
    sha256 = sha256_file(path),
    status = "read-back checks passed"
  )
  print(verification[[key]])
}

# Inputs must be unchanged after processing.
for (key in names(input_paths)) {
  stopifnot(identical(sha256_file(input_paths[[key]]), input_fingerprints[[key]]))
}
```

## 執行結果

2026-11-08 以乾淨 R 程序（`Rscript --vanilla`，`knitr::knit()` 輸出至暫存位置）完整執行。以下為實際輸出：

- 輸入核對：manifest 與 365 個原始檔全部與 SHA-256 一致；臺北站 33,980 筆觀測，缺值代碼與 `D24R` 假設核對結果與 60 分鐘版相同。
- 觀測時間分布：分鐘為 :00／:10／:30／:40 者 8,391／8,140／8,308／8,177 筆，:20／:50 者 532／432 筆；相鄰間隔 10 分鐘 16,999 次、20 分鐘 16,519 次，30 分鐘以上 404 次（2024 年 160 次）。
- 輸出 35,040 列（365 天 × 96 個 15 分鐘區間）。
- `Temp`／`HUMD`：33,270 個區間用區間內讀數，981 個區間用前一區間（15–30 分鐘前）的讀數，789 個區間缺值（2.3%，2024 年為 0.8%）。`Temp` 與 `HUMD` 全年同時缺值。最長連續缺溫度為 2025-04-11 19:00 起 60 個區間（15 小時，與 60 分鐘版同一段）。
- `D24R`、`D24R_trace`：2,060 個區間缺值（區間內沒有讀數）。
- `rain`：1 = 1,685 個區間（4.8%）、0 = 31,253、`NA` = 2,102（2,060 個區間內無讀數，42 個因前一筆讀數早於 t − 30 分鐘而無法判斷）。其中 141 個區間只因 `D24R` 由 0 變成雨跡而記為 1；沒有雨跡退回 0 的情形。月別降雨區間數 49（8 月）至 251（5 月）。
- 讀回檢查全部通過：欄名、列數、`datetime` 每 15 分鐘連續不重複、`rain` 只有 0／1／`NA`、`HUMD` 介於 0–1、`weather_age_min` 介於 0–30，數值與寫出前一致；輸入檔執行後未改變。
- 輸出：`data/processed/weather_taipei_2025_15min.csv`，35,040 列 × 7 欄，1,447.5 KB。
